name: A Simple Letter A Silly Love
source:
Reed is a young alchemist living in the town of Boatsworth, he's so far avoided romance, but what happens when a secret love letter gets sent out by mistake to the the pregnant woman he just so happens to be very fond of?

[From [url=https://thecrimsondmsfw.itch.io/a-simple-letter-a-silly-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
里德是一位住在博茨沃斯镇的年轻炼金术士，他迄今为止一直回避浪漫，但是当一封秘密情书被误寄给他恰好非常喜欢的孕妇时，会发生什么呢？

[来自[url=https://thecrimsondmsfw.itch.io/a-simple-letter-a-silly-love]Itch.io[/url]]
